visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Wrong Expected Sum
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The numbers 0 to 9 are present except 8, but the program prints -1 instead of 8.

solution.explanation: The numbers run from 0 to n, so their sum is n * (n + 1) / 2 (45 for n = 9). n * (n - 1) / 2 is the sum up to n - 1, which is off by n, and the difference no longer points at the missing value.
